faqs.q: Can shoppers design the front and back of a shirt?
faqs.a: Yes. Every side you set up, like front, back and sleeves, gets its own print area and preview.

faqs.q: Can I sell team jerseys with names and numbers?
faqs.a: Yes. Shoppers add names and numbers in the editor, and each order includes the details for production.

faqs.q: Can I offer embroidery and printing on the same product?
faqs.a: Yes. Add several printing methods to one product and give each its own pricing.
Yes. Every custom order comes with print-ready files and the full design details.
